purpose: Responsive image compositions of the approved living-room hero. No layout or typography changes.

images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story / compositing. Asset type: final responsive website hero art, adaptation of the attached APPROVED living-room illustration. Image 1 is the exact scene/character identity/style reference. Image 2 is the exact orange shield character to preserve. Recompose and extend the SAME cozy ordinary human apartment living room, nighttime city window and curtains, sofa, cushions, bookshelves, plants and a warm floor lamp. Preserve soft beautifully painted 2D pixel storybook art with rounded plump electronic characters, gently shaded details and bright cyan digital coffee table. NOT 3D voxel or Minecraft. Exactly SEVEN distinct friends: blue scalloped cloud screen head with cyan terminal eyes, black suit and teal tie; cream microphone with dark round mesh top, teal U-shaped support and gold pivots; ivory-bezel yellow square pixel; cream USB connector with orange gloves, blue arms/legs and absolutely NO CABLE TAIL; cream-mint envelope character; green microchip with big black glasses and gold pins; ornate orange living SHIELD with friendly ivory face, TEAL TIE, CYAN KEYHOLE, orange hands/feet. One of each, no duplicates or additional figures. All seven clearly visible around ONE glowing digital coffee table. No text whatsoever, no names, labels, letters, numbers, logos, captions, watermarks or UI panels. Intrinsic abstract face/USB/keyhole symbols can remain. Warm amber lamps against cool blue night window. Preserve the approved identities and scene mood. This is a composition adaptation, not new character design.
Output canvas: landscape 16:9, target 2560x1440. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: frame the scene from farther back so ALL SEVEN characters and the ENTIRE digital coffee table fit together inside the RIGHTMOST SIXTY PERCENT of the image, x=40% to 97%, mainly in the lower half y=45% to 95%. Every head and both table corners must be visible and safely inside the frame, no cropped figures. Characters are gathered naturally in two staggered rows around the table; the little yellow pixel may hover just above them. LEFT FORTY PERCENT x=0% to40% must remain a quiet, darker, low contrast illustrated living-room area reserved for long web text that will be added later. Use a dim night window with curtains, dark sofa edge and gentle furniture shadows on the left: still a continuous richly illustrated room, never a flat rectangle/block, no fake gradient panel, no writing. Keep brightest lamp and table light on the right. Empty room above the characters lets all heads breathe. The visible cast should fit the right side without forcing a close-up.
